---
title: Freeing a stuck carriage
summary: Old oil is the usual cause.
topic: carriage
---

A carriage that refuses to travel has usually been oiled by somebody who meant well thirty years ago. The oil turned to varnish on the rails. Wipe both rails with mineral spirits on a lint free rag, work the carriage by hand from margin to margin, and repeat until the rag comes away clean. Only then decide whether the mainspring needs another half turn of tension.
